headline: How to breed the Lightning Dragon
title: How to Breed Lightning Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends | Energy + Wind | DML Breeding Guide
video_script: Want the Lightning Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends? Breed two dragons that together carry the Energy and Wind elements. No combination is guaranteed, so you may need a few tries. Tip: higher level and rarer parents give you better odds of a rare dragon. Which dragon should I cover next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Higher level parents = better rare odds

description: Dragon Mania Legends: breed two dragons that together carry Energy and Wind to get the Lightning Dragon. No combination is guaranteed. Element combos checked on the DML wiki and the TouchTapPlay breeding guide.
